title: What Does It Mean 'To Mushroom'? (1/2)
summaryZh: 以蘑菇一夜之間冒出來為例，說明這個字當動詞表示快速暴增。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: And now, words and their stories from VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: 現在是 VOA 學英語的《Words and Their Stories》單元。

sentences.text: Mushrooms are a popular food in many parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界上很多地方，蘑菇都是很受歡迎的食物。

sentences.text: Some people even like to go out into the woods, or forest, to pick wild mushrooms.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至喜歡到林子裡、也就是森林裡去採野生蘑菇。

sentences.text: They know which ones to eat and where they grow.
sentences.zh: 他們知道哪些可以吃，也知道它們長在哪裡。

sentences.text: Mushrooms grow very quickly, often overnight.
sentences.zh: 蘑菇長得非常快，常常一個晚上就冒出來。

sentences.text: Dark, wet areas in the forest might be without mushrooms one day and filled with fungi by the next day.
sentences.zh: 森林裡陰暗潮濕的地方，今天可能一朵蘑菇都沒有，隔天就長滿了菇類。

sentences.text: The mushrooms have sprung up overnight.
sentences.zh: 這些蘑菇一夜之間就冒了出來。

sentences.text: To spring up means to appear or develop suddenly or quickly.
sentences.zh: spring up 的意思是突然或很快地出現、發展起來。

sentences.text: So we can compare things that grow fast, or increase suddenly, to springing up like mushrooms.
sentences.zh: 所以我們可以把長得很快、突然暴增的東西，形容成像蘑菇一樣冒出來。

sentences.text: For example, because there are many online streaming platforms, new programs are springing up like mushrooms.
sentences.zh: 舉例來說，因為網路上的串流平台很多，新節目就像雨後春筍一樣冒出來。

sentences.text: We can also use mushroom as a verb, meaning to grow or expand widely and over a short period of time.
sentences.zh: 我們也可以把 mushroom 當動詞用，意思是在短時間內大幅成長或擴張。

sentences.text: For example, schools in the city improved greatly, and the number of parks increased as well.
sentences.zh: 舉例來說，這座城市的學校進步很多，公園的數量也增加了。

sentences.text: So the number of families moving to the area mushroomed in recent years.
sentences.zh: 所以近幾年搬到這一帶的家庭數量就暴增了。

sentences.text: Good things and bad things can develop quickly.
sentences.zh: 好事和壞事都有可能發展得很快。

sentences.text: If a problem or issue gets bigger very quickly, we can say it mushroomed.
sentences.zh: 如果一個問題很快就變得更嚴重，我們就可以說它 mushroomed。
